target_customer: Product managers and product teams at software companies
problem: Teams struggle to know which customers want which features and what they are worth. Cardinal pulled feedback, CRM data and issues together and used AI to rank the backlog.
product_category: AI product management and feedback analysis

founders.name: Nadav Weizmann
founders.background_notes: Per the launch post the founders led product and engineering at Epic Games and Houseparty and had worked together about 15 years

founders.name: Mor Sela
founders.background_notes: Led engineering teams through product development and acquisitions

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrations with CRM, support and issue trackers plus an LLM scoring layer were standard engineering, with some difficulty in mapping feedback to revenue.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and accumulated customer data created modest lock-in, but the idea was easy for incumbent feedback and product tools to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Miro acquired the team and relaunched the product as Miro Insights, announced in May 2024.

market_need_then: Product teams in 2023 faced scattered customer feedback across tools and large language models made automated synthesis feasible.

branding.domain_note: Beta signup at cardinalapp.io, not the .com.

rebrands.why: Product folded into Miro after the acquisition

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found. The name is confusable with at least two other Cardinal startups, including a W26 YC company and CardinalOps.

outcome_analysis: Cardinal went through YC in Winter 2023 with founders who had already sold Houseparty and worked at Epic Games and had product depth in this exact workflow. It was acquired by Miro in May 2024 and became Miro Insights, with Weizmann joining as a VP of Product. Price and terms are not disclosed, and no priced funding round was found, so the outcome looks like a team and product acquisition by a company that owned the product workspace.
notes: Funding seen only on aggregators (about $500K YC pre-seed, April 2023) so not recorded as a round (unverified). cardinalapp.io could not be fetched (host did not resolve in this session), so the old site status is unverified; Miro Insights now lives at insights.miro.com. Acquisition date conflicts: archive page says announced 2024-05-23, Sidley page is dated 2024-05-28, Miro says Winter 2024. Competitor list left empty: the dated search returned only Miro and acquisition pages and named no competitors. Do not confuse with trycardinal.ai (YC W26) or CardinalOps. Completeness pass: Pre-seed of about $500K from Y Combinator dated April 2023 rests on aggregators (VCBacked total, altss profile), no press. Cross-check search found no press release on funding.
